description: This file defines a MedicalAgent class that performs template-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for medical recommendations. It loads a vector store, retrieves relevant guideline snippets, and generates user-facing advice with optional medicine suggestions and safety disclaimers.

classes.name: MedicalAgent
classes.description: A class that provides health recommendations based on keyword heuristics and retrieved guideline snippets, including safety alerts and medicine suggestions.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the MedicalAgent by loading the vector store.

methods.name: List[str] _medicine_suggestions(self, user_query: str)
methods.description: Provides heuristic medicine suggestions with safety warnings based on user query keywords.

methods.name: List[str] _dedupe_preserve_order(self, items: List[str])
methods.description: Removes duplicate strings from a list while maintaining original order.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves relevant guidelines and generates a list of recommendations, including safety disclaimers and optional medicine suggestions.
